title: Sign your Independent Contractor Agreement
description: Review and sign the PNCL Independent Contractor Agreement. A signed PDF is saved to your profile and is required before you can get started.

title: Complete your profile
description: Provide all the required information — your name MUST be your legal name. Add a profile photo and keep your details current.

title: Upload your driver's license
description: Upload a clear and legible image of your driver's license to your profile.

title: Complete your W-9 form
description: Submit your IRS Form W-9 so PNCL can process commission payments. This is required before you can get started.

title: Set up direct deposit
description: Submit your direct deposit request so PNCL can pay commissions straight to your bank account. A signed PDF is saved to your profile.

title: Sign your comp agreement
description: Sign your compensation attachment in PNCL Hub so we know how to pay you. PNCL assigns this document after your ICA is signed.

title: Complete PNCL training
description: Watch all current PNCL training videos and confirm each module when complete.

title: Exam study tools
description: Use this free training resource to prepare for your exam — use the code "Quantum25".

title: Schedule your exam
description: Schedule your exam at a local facility or online through Prometric. Go to "Find Your Exam" and search for your home state and "insurance." This will populate a list of options. You are looking for "Life Insurance Producer" or some form of it.

title: Take your exam
description: Good luck!

title: Apply for your license (NPN)
description: Apply for your "Individual" license at NIPR.com.

title: Complete fingerprinting
description: On-site facilities will complete this when you take your test. If you take it online, you need to schedule fingerprints separately.

title: Record your NPN in PNCL Hub
description: Add your NPN to your profile as soon as you have it.

title: Get E&O insurance
description: Purchase E&O coverage at NAPA-Benefits.org — you will need the "Newly Licensed <2 yrs." option, and select "Option A".

title: Record your E&O policy number in PNCL Hub
description: Add your errors and omissions policy number to your profile.

title: Watch the SureLC tutorial video
description: Watch the full SureLC walkthrough before creating your accounts or submitting carrier applications. The next steps unlock automatically when the video finishes.

title: Watch the IBO SureLC tutorial video
description: Watch the full IBO SureLC walkthrough before creating your accounts or submitting carrier applications. The next steps unlock automatically when the video finishes. Keep the quick reference PDF handy while you complete your contracting.

title: Create SureLC account #1 — "Basso Montemurro"
description:
Create a separate SureLC account under "Basso-Montemurro". In this account, request ONLY:
• American Amicable
• American General Life (AIG/Corebridge)
• American Home Life
• Liberty Bankers Life
• Royal Neighbors

title: Create SureLC account #2 — "The Pinnacle Life Group"
description:
Create a separate SureLC account under "The Pinnacle Life Group". In this account, request ONLY:
• Banner (Beyond Term)
• Fidelity & Guaranty

title: Create SureLC account #3 — "Pinnacle Life Group"
description:
Create a separate SureLC account under "Pinnacle Life Group". In this account, request ONLY:
• AuguStar
• Foresters
• Kansas City Life
• Mutual of Omaha
• Transamerica

title: Submit applications for recommended carriers
description:
Submit applications ONLY for the carriers listed under each separate SureLC account:
• SureLC #1, "Basso-Montemurro": American Amicable, American General Life (AIG/Corebridge), American Home Life, Liberty Bankers Life, Royal Neighbors
• SureLC #2, "The Pinnacle Life Group": Banner (Beyond Term), Fidelity & Guaranty
• SureLC #3, "Pinnacle Life Group": AuguStar, Foresters, Kansas City Life, Mutual of Omaha, Transamerica
• Ethos and United Home Life: links are sent to your PNCL email automatically. No SureLC request is needed.

title: Submit for New Producer
description: MANDATORY - YOU WILL NOT GET ANY CARRIER CONTRACTS WITHOUT COMPLETING THIS STEP. Once every step above is complete, submit for New Producer. This notifies the PNCL team so your profile can be built in PLG's back-end system.

title: Apply for additional state licenses
description: Apply for additional states so you can get leads and sell in more areas than your resident state. Apply at NIPR.com.

title: Update your profile with new state licenses
description: Add states in your profile as you get additional licenses.

title: Receive carrier assignments
description: Keep an eye on your email for welcome letters with writing numbers from each carrier. This can take 3 days to 3 weeks.

title: Record your carrier writing numbers
description: Add writing numbers to your profile as you get them.

title: Create carrier credentials
description: Use your writing numbers to create a login for each carrier so you can quote and write business.

title: Enter carrier credentials into PNCL Hub
description: Add each carrier login (username and password) to your profile for easy documentation.

title: Create a Discord account and join the PNCL server
description: Set up Discord (or sign in if you already have an account), then join our community server for announcements, training, and support.

title: Create your LeadSpply account
description: Sign up at LeadSpply using your @thepncl.com email so leads and quotes stay tied to your PNCL account.

title: Follow PNCL on Instagram
description: Follow @thepncl_ on Instagram for updates, culture posts, and agent highlights.

title: Follow PNCL on LinkedIn
description: Follow The PNCL on LinkedIn to stay connected with company news and opportunities.

title: Follow PNCL on Facebook
description: Like and follow PNCL on Facebook for announcements and community updates.
